title: Binary charge calculation
software_contract: minimum_energy(biases, couplings) returns the exact least value of sum(biases[i]*x[i]) + sum(w*x[i]*x[j] for (i,j,w) in couplings) over binary x. All bit vectors including all-zero are allowed. Repeated/reversed coupling entries and self-couplings are additive, not deduplicated. Empty biases and couplings return zero. Return only the value, not an assignment; do not mutate inputs. Only valid-domain behavior is specified; no new invalid-input validation is promised.
input_domain: Finite list biases of signed Python integers (not bool); finite list couplings of triples of Python integers (not bool), indices in [0,len(biases)), signed weights. No length or integer cap. The paired catalogue context disallows self-adjustments as a business rule and adds a constant base charge; the full core domain is broader.
execution_assumptions: Ordinary classical coefficients; no hardware, runtime target or benefit evidence is supplied.
